args.prompt:
Create ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 TRANSPARENT PNG, EXACTLY SIX unique KFB INK BLOB MONSTERS in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Historical woodland outlaw/robber gang, loose Schiller Die Räuber / Sturm-und-Drang mood, late18th/early19th-century ragged coats, slouch hats, scarves, leather and dull iron. Grimmish, wicked-looking, dangerous attitudes but quirky and relatable, each a flawed individual with a different temperament. Two female-read. No exact literary character portraits, modern gangster gear, pirate skulls or text.
The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for complete rounded dark ink body, sculpted lids and soft rich plasticine; second for the craft of clay accessories. New subjects, not copies of reference outfits/faces.
Every actor ONE continuous COMPLETE UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat, subtle deep violet sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, face directly in goo, two short rounded goo hands, a few contained ink drops. No human torso/legs/feet, bust, fur body or angular rock anatomy. Partial costume only: one short shoulder panel/lapel/scarf, most body remains bare dark ink. Fine tactile plasticine with soft modeled volumes/fingerprints and selective seams/wear, weird offbeat cartoon, not Pixar human mascots.
All visible eyes WHITE/IVORY EYEBALLS around distinct RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL, thick violet-black clay lids. No all-red glowing eyes, masks, eyewear or eyepatches. Different facial proportions, gaze, lid/brow weights, mouth openings and lip shapes. Irregular ivory teeth, no six identical angry grins, no dangling tongues. No gore, attack scene, victims, environment or writing.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ ROBBER CAPTAIN, grand grievance and wounded pride. Tall broad pear blob with one hooked crown loop, battered dark charcoal wide-brim SLOUCH HAT, one short rusty-red scarf and small dull brass clasp. Cold furious self-command: one white eye narrowed and other wider, brows extremely unequal, clenched crooked teeth in a shallow sideways mouth, huge heavy lower lip. Holds ONE SHORT OLD FLINTLOCK PISTOL with thick wooden grip and single dull steel barrel upright close beside own body, pointing upward within own cell, other hand grips the end of own scarf. No aiming at anyone or heroic human uniform.
TOP MIDDLE — MALE-READ HIGHWAY BRUISER, stubborn intimidator secretly careful with belongings. Very wide low bean blob, three fat crown nubs, one torn brown jacket shoulder and broad leather belt scrap with single iron buckle. One enormous white eye stares UP and other squints, tightly compressed angry pout with two huge uneven lower teeth, forehead heavily crumpled. Both hands cradle ONE SHORT KNOTTED WOODEN CUDGEL against belly; a tiny faded BLUE CLOTH RIBBON is carefully knotted round its handle. Entire weapon contained in cell, no raised swing or muscular arms.
TOP RIGHT — FEMALE-READ PICKPOCKET, calculating black humour. Compact wavy-edged pear splat, two short dark clay side curls, small worn ochre bonnet pushed behind face and a torn ivory cuff at one goo wrist. Very sly hostile amusement: one huge white eye looks SIDEWAYS, opposite eye almost squints, one arched brow and a near-closed lopsided smile with one irregular upper fang. Holds ONE fat worn LEATHER COIN PURSE clasped low at belly; other hand draws ONE oversized brass KEY halfway from the purse. No jewellery pile or theft gesture toward another actor. Face completely uncovered.
BOTTOM LEFT — FEMALE-READ OUTLAW LOOKOUT, bitter defiance with alert nerves. Tall hooked kidney blob, faded TEAL HEADSCARF and one small patched grey shoulder fold, subtle lashes, two short clay braid ends. Suspicious outraged glance UP sideways, unequal white eyes, sharply lifted one brow, skewed shallow open mouth with three clenched uneven teeth and huge lower lip. Holds ONE SHORT WOODEN-STOCK MUSKET upright close alongside own body, clear stock/barrel, other goo hand holds ONE OPEN IRON WRIST SHACKLE with only TWO short dangling links against belly. No wound, prison scene or hidden eyes.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ INEXPERIENCED BURGLAR, trying ferociously to look competent. Round top-heavy crooked ink dumpling, floppy small brown cap, one tiny frayed ochre neck fold. Anxious nasty concentration: very wide uneven white eyes stare DOWN at own hands, inner brows high while corners scowl, tiny clenched mouth with one central tooth and protruding heavy lower lip. Clutches ONE absurdly large CLOSED IRON PADLOCK and ONE small fat BENT KEY beside its keyhole, clear separate chunky shapes. No detailed lockpicking mechanism, instruction diagram or extra tools. This is a character gag about his own difficulty, not action against another figure.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ LOOT KEEPER / TREACHEROUS FENCE. Broad squat diamond-like soft splat with short rumpled clay side hair, battered dark red merchant cap and one muted brown checked shoulder scrap. Deep greedy distrust, heavy white eyes look SIDEWAYS in different squints, one eyebrow curled higher, almost CLOSED sneering lip with two small widely spaced teeth. Both hands protect ONE small thick WOODEN CASH BOX with hinged lid slightly open; exactly THREE large GOLD COINS visible inside, no scattered loot. His grip is much more frightened than his expression admits.

COMPOSITION: six LARGE complete self-contained actors in regular3x2 grid, similar substantial body height across both rows. Full silhouettes450-465px within each512pxlogical cell, keep clear margins/gutters especially32-40px between rows; intentionally fit hats/weapons/keys/boxes/droplets inside own cells. No neighbors touching/overlap/props across seams, no cut-off details or miniature bottom row. Costume never replaces ink anatomy. No gridlines, floor, cast-shadow disc, background gradient, checkerboard, halo, lettering, watermark or floating punctuation. Real alpha-zero transparent surroundings, opaque character interiors and clean antialias. Soft upper-left studio lighting only on figures.
